scope: Search for reusable bulk public datasets with attraction ticket prices and/or opening hours, then assess safe importability into data/china_attractions.json.
conclusion: No nationwide, current, openly licensed dataset with both fields and a verifiable bulk download was found. Existing public-source imports remain the safest data currently added. Commercial or permission-gated sources are recorded as leads, not imported.

resources.name: CnOpenData China attractions and ratings database
resources.coverage_claim: More than one million attractions nationwide; data through 2025-06; lists market/actual price and opening hours.
resources.access: Paid/licensed subscription; complete download and API require purchase/contact.
resources.decision: Not downloaded or imported. Could be reconsidered only after license, freshness, field provenance, and cost are reviewed.

resources.name: China City Attraction Details / Qunar-derived community dataset
resources.coverage_claim: 352 cities x 100 places, with admission and opening-hour fields.
resources.access: Community dataset linked to Kaggle; page says data was scraped from Qunar and provides only educational-use notice, with no clear reuse license. Snapshot is about two years old.
resources.decision: Not imported because provenance/license is unclear and ticket/hour values are stale-risk.

resources.name: China scenic attraction collection (2022-06-03)
resources.coverage_claim: Approximately 12,000 attractions; page says ticket prices and opening hours are included.
resources.access: Download is gated by login/credits; source provenance and redistribution license are not stated on the page.
resources.decision: Not downloaded or imported. Age and provenance make it unsuitable as direct truth without an audit.

resources.name: Beijing government open data: graded scenic-area ticket prices
resources.coverage_claim: 218 Beijing records with fee status and seasonal prices; published 2026-01-20.
resources.access: The data page documents API access via a registered userKey. Existing detail-page enrichment covered 15 prices and 3 opening-hour values from public attraction pages; the dataset API was not called.
resources.decision: Keep as an official-source lead; API bulk access requires account credential.

resources.name: Wenzhou government open data: scenic-area information
resources.coverage_claim: 91 records; includes opening hours and ticket price fields.
resources.access: Only 10 public preview rows were visible; full API requires registered appsecret. Preview had no exact name match in this KB, and average-price=0 is not proof of a free ticket.
resources.decision: No KB rows imported. No access-control bypass attempted.

resources.name: Shenzhen government open data: sightseeing-spot ticket price table
resources.access: Official portal labels the resource unconditional open, but direct non-browser retrieval returned HTTP 403 in this session; no file was obtained.
resources.decision: Not imported. If browser download becomes available, reassess freshness and exact KB matches before applying.

resources.name: OpenStreetMap China PBF fee/opening_hours tags
resources.coverage_claim: Current PBF scanned against linked attraction IDs; per-object fee/charge/opening_hours tags.
resources.access: Public download; source IDs and object links retained.
resources.decision: Imported only exact linked-object tags where KB fields were empty. Expanded exact-name, point-to-way-geometry review added 1,861 unique OSM way IDs. Current OSM-sourced values are 126 ticket/fee labels and 163 opening-hours texts; the latest way-linked import added 24 ticket/fee labels and 4 opening-hours texts. All remain unverified because OSM tags are not official current operating guarantees.
